name: CES - Columbia Electric Supply
old_description: Manufacturing innovation and technology have never moved faster, and finding answers to today's challenges can be difficult. With a local teammate bringing solutions and products right to your door, you can find the answers you need to help you reach your goals and succeed.
about:
Based in Idaho Falls, Idaho, CES (Columbia Electric Supply) operates as a local integrated partner for industrial manufacturers across the Intermountain West. The company does not publicly disclose its founding year, ownership structure, or founder names.

CES supplies a mix of hardware, software, and consulting services aimed at digitizing and connecting manufacturing data, processes, and people. Its portfolio includes Rockwell Automation motor-control products such as the M100 line, the FactoryXT smart-manufacturing platform, and Grace Technologies ChekVolt voltage testers. The firm also provides solution consulting, industrial network design and cybersecurity services, and workforce training programs built on pre‑defined learning pathways. No facility size, headcount, or production volumes are published.

The company serves customers in water and wastewater treatment, food and beverage processing, timber, and energy sectors. Its client base consists of plant operators and engineering teams looking to modernize existing facilities or deploy new automation systems.

CES positions itself as an integrated partner that works alongside customers on both current projects and future roadmaps, emphasizing on‑site presence and a consultative approach to optimize operations and maximize productivity.
